project.domain: Kernel boot-image admission and pre-handoff validation
project.mission: Validate kernel image metadata, bounds, manifests, hashes, and boot information before any future handoff.

explicit_non_goals: Validator does not execute image code
Validator does not replace firmware or bootloader
Image hash equality does not establish publisher identity
Secure Boot, publisher signing, key rotation, and TPM attestation are not implied

safety_boundaries: Validate file path, size, architecture, entry offset, alignment, and memory map bounds before admission.
Do not represent unsigned artifacts as authenticated.
Any future handoff or hardware execution requires a separate threat model and qualification.

native_validation.evidence_note: Host validation and QEMU boot checks do not prove arbitrary physical-device compatibility.
